{How should Black play against White's greedy queen move?} 4... d6 {[%wrong
White is better. Try again and look for a good move to defend your knight.] 
[%hint Release a bishop to defend your knight on g4.]} (4... Bb4+ $5 5. Bd2 {
If you were planning the exciting Qg5 next, good work! There's another strong
option as well. Try to find it.}) (4... Nh6 $2 5. Nf3 {The knight is poorly
placed on h6 and White is doing well. Try to find a move to help you develop
and defend the knight.}) (4... Qh4 $2 5. h3 {White will use the pin on the
fourth rank to win material. Try to find a better way to defend your knight.})
5. exd6 {Good move. How should you recapture on d6?} Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture and
develop a piece.]} (5... Nc6 $5 {That's just as good as our main line. Well
done! Can you also find a good way to capture on d6?}) (5... Qxd6 $2 6. Qxd6 {
Typically you don't want to trade when you're down a pawn. Try again.}) (5...
cxd6 $2 6. Nc3 {White is better. Try again.}) 6. Qxg7 {Black was doing well
anyway, but White's last move was a big mistake. How can Black win material?}
Be5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again.] [%hint Find the best way to attack
the white queen.]} (6... Qf6 $2 7. Qxf6 {White is doing well after the trade
of queens. Try to find a better way to attack the white queen.}) 7. Qg5 {
Nice move! What should you capture?} Qxg5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move.
Try again and look for a winning capture.] [%hint Trade queens to decoy the
defender of the b2-pawn.]} (7... Bf6 $2 8. Qb5+ {White is OK. Try again and
look for a good capture.}) (7... Bxb2 $2 8. Qxd8+ {White will capture on b2
next and Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 8.
Bxg5 {Good choice! What can you capture next?} Bxb2 {[%wrong There's a much
stronger option. Try to find the best capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
pawn.] Well done! White has no way to save the a1-rook and Black is winning.} (
8... Nxh2 $2 9. Nc3 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (8... Bxh2 $2 9. g3 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) 1-0
